post.description: First staff login: create the authenticator secret and return it as a QR code link.
Staff login, step 2: check the 6-digit code, then open the session with mfa=true.
Get a new access token using the refresh cookie. The cookie is replaced too.
End the session: the refresh token stops working and the cookie is removed.
Send a reset link. Same answer, and same speed, whether or not the account exists.
Choose a new password with the link's token. Every session is then cancelled.
